status: found by reproducing the order in the build session; each is a question for the reviewer (and, through the operator, the licensee) — none is resolved by the build

findings.title: UPCL's claimed interest on working capital (210.62) is not its stated rate on its stated requirement (12.45 % × 1,678.73 = 209.00)
findings.detail: Table 4.50 prints UPCL's claimed working capital requirement 1,678.73 — its five components add to it exactly — and its rate 12.45 %; 12.45 % of 1,678.73 is 209.00, but the claimed interest is 210.62 (an implied rate of 12.546 %).  Table 4.52 carries the same 210.62 as UPCL's claim.  The approved column is consistent (12.38 % × 1,563.67 = 193.58).  The difference does not reach the approval; it is a question about the claim as the order reports it.
where: UERC order on UPCL FY2026-27, p.219 Table 4.50; p.223 Table 4.52

findings.title: One month of power purchase (867.48) matches no printed annual total
findings.detail: Para 4.13.5 says 'as per the Power Purchase approved, one month of power purchase cost worked out by the Commission is Rs. 867.48 Crore'.  Twelve months of it is 10,409.76; the order prints power purchase with RPO, water tax and arrears of 9,340.23 (Table 4.33, 4.52), 8,338.35 without arrears and water tax, and transmission charges of 1,246.85 (Table 4.36) — 10,587.08 with power purchase.  None gives 867.48.  The figure enters the working capital as a record; the rest of the computation reproduces (14 of 18 checks; the requirement within a paisa).
where: UERC order on UPCL FY2026-27, p.219 para 4.13.5; p.201 Table 4.33; p.203 Table 4.36

findings.title: UPCL's claimed R&M (637.10) follows from its opening GFA 11,814.94, not the GFAn-1 of 11,682.50 printed in the same row
findings.detail: Table 4.43 prints UPCL's K 5.30 %, GFAn-1 11,682.50 and WPI 1.73 %: K × GFA × (1 + WPI) = 629.88, not the claimed 637.10.  With the opening GFA UPCL claims for FY2026-27 in Table 4.38 (11,814.94) the formula gives 637.02 — within K's printed precision of 637.10.  The approved R&M uses the opening GFA of the year (11,152.19), as the order says.  Which GFA UPCL meant is a question for the licensee; it does not change the approval.
where: UERC order on UPCL FY2026-27, p.214 Table 4.43; p.206 Table 4.38

findings.title: UPCL's A&G capitalisation rate: 13.26 % in Table 4.44, 13.36 % in the text — the 11.72 capitalised follows from 13.36 %
findings.detail: Para 4.11.3 (b) reports UPCL's 'capitalization rate of 13.36 % based on actual capitalization rate of FY 2024-25'; Table 4.44 prints 13.26 %.  13.36 % of the gross 87.72 is 11.72, the figure capitalised; 13.26 % would give 11.63.  The table's rate reads as a misprint.  The approved column (21.42 %) is consistent.
where: UERC order on UPCL FY2026-27, p.214 para 4.11.3 (b); p.215 Table 4.44

findings.title: UPCL's O&M claim: 1,237.35 in Table 4.45, 1,221.50 in Table 4.52 (and in its working capital)
findings.detail: Table 4.45 totals UPCL's claimed O&M at 1,237.35 (481.38 + 637.10 + 118.87, which add).  Table 4.52 prints UPCL's O&M as 1,221.50, and UPCL's claimed one month of O&M in its working capital (101.79, Table 4.50) is 1,221.50 / 12.  The note to Table 4.52 says its column is UPCL's revised claim of 20.03.2026, which may explain the 15.85; the order does not say which components changed.
where: UERC order on UPCL FY2026-27, p.215 Table 4.45; p.223 Table 4.52; p.219 Table 4.50

findings.title: Table 3.46's row 'Sales at Approved Loss of 13.00 %' carries UPCL's sales at 13.25 %
findings.detail: UPCL's column of Table 3.46 prints 14,914.28 MU against the row label 'Sales at Approved Loss of 13.00 % (MU)'; 17,192.26 × (1 − 13.00 %) is 14,957.27, and 14,914.28 is the energy input at 13.25 % — the loss UPCL's own Table 3.44 names ('Sales at Actual Energy Input with 13.25 % Loss').  Para 3.3 gives the approved baseline as 13.00 %.  UPCL's claim therefore measured its excess loss against 13.25 %, understating the loss of sales (76.06 MU against 119.05 MU at 13.00 % on its own sales).  The Commission's column uses 13.00 % and re-cast sales.
where: UERC order on UPCL FY2026-27, p.166 Table 3.44; p.167 Table 3.46; p.165 para 3.3
